how-to-play.text1: Get ready to quiz, learn, and laugh with — the ultimate brain-boosting challenge for kids!
how-to-play.text2: Packed with fun facts and cool questions, each card tests your smarts on everything from brushing basics to tooth-friendly snacks.
how-to-play.text3: Whether you're playing solo or going head-to-head with friends, every correct answer earns smiles, and every wrong one is a chance to learn.
how-to-play.text4: It's the perfect way to make healthy habits stick — one flashcard at a time! 🍎😄

about-us.text1: We are a diverse team of young professionals 👩‍⚕️👨‍🎓 and students from various academic backgrounds, including dentistry 🦷, medicine 🏥, nutrition 🥗, psychology 🧠, fine arts 🎨, and software engineering 💻.
about-us.text2: United by a shared goal of promoting oral health education 🪥, we combined our diverse skills to create Tooth or Dare 🎮—a fun, interactive game designed to teach adolescents 👦👧 about oral hygiene and nutrition in an engaging and memorable way ✨.
